red.title: Severe acute malnutrition
red.action: The health worker refers the child for treatment the same day. Ikibondo marks the child high risk and alerts the nurse.

yellow.title: Moderate acute malnutrition
yellow.action: The child is enrolled in supplementary feeding and measured again at the next visit. Ikibondo schedules the follow-up.

green.title: No acute malnutrition
green.action: Growth is on track. The health worker keeps to the routine visit schedule.

muac.note: WHO cut-offs for children aged 6–59 months. A MUAC reading is one input; oedema and weight-for-height are checked too.

faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.subtitle: If your question isn't here, ask your camp supervisor.

notes.1: Gaining well, close to the median.
notes.4: Weight dropped since the last visit. Ikibondo flags the child and the CHW refers her to the nurse.
notes.5: Enrolled in supplementary feeding after the referral. Gaining again.
notes.6: Back near her earlier growth line.

growthChart.title: A child's weight plotted against WHO growth bands
growthChart.desc: The child follows the median until month 6, falls toward minus two standard deviations at month 8, is referred, and returns toward the median by month 15.
growthChart.hint: Tap a visit on the chart to see what the health worker recorded.
growthChart.caption: Weight-for-age, girls 0–24 months. Illustrative child; bands approximate the WHO Child Growth Standards.
